10 meses

Seguir

Had an amazing time at SITI! 🎉

It was a fantastic opportunity to share the latest Logitech trends and connect with customers about their experiences with the brand. Thank you for the invitation!

To top it all off, I had the privilege of learning from Wendel Clark 🏒 his insights on leadership and those incredible hockey memories were truly inspiring!

Events like SITI are the perfect venue to meet experts from leading manufacturers in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere. 

👉 If you attended and we didn’t get a chance to connect, let’s change that! Reach out, I’d love to explore more opportunities together.

Looking forward to continuing these conversations and building stronger connections!

#SITI #Logitech #Networking #Leadership #CustomerExperience #Hockey #TDSYNNEX
